The follow-up task is created in the [Spec](intent://local/note/spec) and delegated to an implementor. The job: extend `takeoverEdgePulse` so a conflict edge stops pulsing red when either endpoint is `cancelled` (not just `complete`), rendering it static + muted, with the status-matrix tests updated to pin the new rule. Per your "and push" instruction, the implementor will cut `fix/hud-cancelled-conflict-pulse` from latest main, run the full check suite, push, and open the cloudlands-fe PR.

Ending my turn — I'll resume when the implementor reports back with the PR number, then spawn a PR reviewer per repo convention.
